demo.title: What happens on the demo
demo.lead: A working session with our team, built around your own documents and questions rather than a generic presentation.

items.title: Your documents and questions
items.body: Bring a contract, a document set or a legal question your team is working on. We work through it together in the Assistant, a vault, a review table or court practice analysis, whichever fits the task. If a document is confidential, a redacted copy works well.

items.title: Security and data flow
items.body: We walk your security team through the data flow: sign-in, encryption of uploaded files and pseudonymisation of personal identifiers in typed messages, including what it does not cover. We also cover the third-party AI model and search providers we use, some of which process data outside Kazakhstan. The current list of sub-processors is available on request.

items.title: Onboarding and your practice profile
items.body: We explain how assisted onboarding works and how your team’s practice profile is set up during it: positions on key terms, deal-breakers, escalation rules and house style. The Assistant and the contract risk scan apply the profile.

items.title: How plans are arranged
items.body: Usage is metered in credits, and plans are arranged with our team. We explain how usage is counted and agree a plan that suits your team’s workload.

demo.bookNote: Pick a time that suits you. The booking page opens in a new tab.

invite.title: Who to invite
invite.text: The head of legal or a partner, a lawyer who will use AdiletAI day to day and, if your company requires it, a colleague from information security.

email.notAdvice: We can’t advise on your legal matters, by e‑mail or otherwise. AdiletAI assists legal professionals and does not provide legal advice.
